descriptionByLocale.en:
In order to strengthen our team, we are looking for a committed personality as an ICT Security Officer, who will support our internal organizational units in the implementation and further development of information security and business continuity management. In this versatile role, you review security and data protection concepts, accompany audits and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. You combine expertise with consulting skills and play a key role in shaping tomorrow’s safety standards.
Your role
• Technical examination of information security and data protection concepts (ISDS concepts) as well as protection needs analyses for projects, products and services
• Ensuring compliance with safety standards, standards and regulatory requirements
• Responsibility for the ISDS acceptance process including quality assurance and approval recommendations
• Advising project leaders and specialist areas on security and data protection issues
• Further development of templates, methods and processes in the area of ISDS
• Preparation, monitoring and follow-up of internal and external audits (e.g. ISO-27001, ISAE-3402)
• Coordination of audit evidence and follow-up of audit findings and improvement measures
• Participation in risk analysis and in the further development of processes, methods and the internal control system (ICS)
Your profile
• Completed training or studies in computer science, business informatics, information security or an equivalent field
• Several years of professional experience in information security, GRC, BCM or audit support
• Good knowledge of standards and frameworks such as ISO 27001, ISO 22301, NIST or BSI basic protection
• Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or ISO 22301
• Experience in the preparation, testing or approval of security concepts
• Structured and independent working methods as well as high quality orientation
• Strong communication and advisory skills
• Very good knowledge of German in word and writing
Your Benefits
• Up to 60% home office possible with a 100% pension
